verses.original: אֵיכָה֩ יָעִ֨יב בְּאַפּ֤וֹ׀ אֲדֹנָי֙ אֶת־ בַּת־ צִיּ֔וֹן הִשְׁלִ֤יךְ מִשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ אֶ֔רֶץ תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹא־ זָכַ֥ר הֲדֹם־ רַגְלָ֖יו בְּי֥וֹם אַפּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ê·ḵāh yā·‘îḇ bə·’ap·pōw ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’eṯ- baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn hiš·lîḵ miš·šā·ma·yim ’e·reṣ tip̄·’e·reṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō- zā·ḵar hă·ḏōm- raḡ·lāw bə·yō·wm ’ap·pōw
verses.literal: How the Lord has covered the Daughter of Zion with the cloud of His anger He has cast the glory of Israel from heaven to earth He has abandoned . . . His footstool . . . in the day of His anger
verses.literalPt: COMO cobriu o Senhor de nuvens na sua ira a filha de Sião! Derrubou do céu à terra a glória de Israel, e não se lembrou do escabelo de seus pés, no dia da sua ira.

verses.original: בִּלַּ֨ע אֲדֹנָ֜י לֹא חָמַ֗ל אֵ֚ת כָּל־ נְא֣וֹת יַעֲקֹ֔ב הָרַ֧ס בְּעֶבְרָת֛וֹ מִבְצְרֵ֥י בַת־ יְהוּדָ֖ה הִגִּ֣יעַ לָאָ֑רֶץ חִלֵּ֥ל מַמְלָכָ֖ה וְשָׂרֶֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: bil·la‘ ’ă·ḏō·nāy lō ḥā·mal ’êṯ kāl- nə·’ō·wṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ hā·ras bə·‘eḇ·rā·ṯōw miḇ·ṣə·rê ḇaṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh hig·gî·a‘ lā·’ā·reṣ ḥil·lêl mam·lā·ḵāh wə·śā·re·hā
verses.literal: Without pity the Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob In His wrath He has demolished the fortified cities of the Daughter of Judah He brought to the ground and defiled her kingdom and its princes
verses.literalPt: Devorou o Senhor todas as moradas de Jacó, e não se apiedou; derrubou no seu furor as fortalezas da filha de Judá, e abateu-as até à terra; profanou o reino e os seus príncipes.

verses.original: גָּדַ֣ע בָּֽחֳרִי אַ֗ף כֹּ֚ל קֶ֣רֶן יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֵשִׁ֥יב אָח֛וֹר יְמִינ֖וֹ מִפְּנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֑ב וַיִּבְעַ֤ר בְּיַעֲקֹב֙ כְּאֵ֣שׁ לֶֽהָבָ֔ה אָכְלָ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃ס
verses.transliteration: gā·ḏa‘ bå̄·ḥo·rī ’ap̄ kōl qe·ren yiś·rā·’êl hê·šîḇ ’ā·ḥō·wr yə·mî·nōw mip·pə·nê ’ō·w·yêḇ way·yiḇ·‘ar bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ kə·’êš le·hā·ḇāh ’ā·ḵə·lāh sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: In fierce anger He has cut off every horn of Israel and withdrawn . . . His right hand at the approach of the enemy He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes everything around it
verses.literalPt: No furor da sua ira cortou toda a força de Israel; retirou para trás a sua destra de diante do inimigo; e ardeu contra Jacó, como labareda de fogo que consome em redor.

verses.original: דָּרַ֨ךְ קַשְׁתּ֜וֹ כְּאוֹיֵ֗ב נִצָּ֤ב יְמִינוֹ֙ כְּצָ֔ר וַֽיַּהֲרֹ֔ג כֹּ֖ל מַחֲמַדֵּי־ עָ֑יִן בְּאֹ֙הֶל֙ בַּת־ צִיּ֔וֹן שָׁפַ֥ךְ כָּאֵ֖שׁ חֲמָתֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: dā·raḵ qaš·tōw kə·’ō·w·yêḇ niṣ·ṣāḇ yə·mî·nōw kə·ṣār way·ya·hă·rōḡ kōl ma·ḥă·mad·dê- ‘ā·yin bə·’ō·hel baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn šā·p̄aḵ kā·’êš ḥă·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: He has bent His bow like an enemy His right hand is positioned Like a foe He has killed all who were pleasing to the eye He has poured out His wrath like fire on the tent of the Daughter of Zion
verses.literalPt: Armou o seu arco como inimigo, firmou a sua destra como adversário, e matou tudo o que era formoso à vista; derramou a sua indignação como fogo na tenda da filha de Sião.

verses.original: הָיָ֨ה אֲדֹנָ֤י׀ כְּאוֹיֵב֙ בִּלַּ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּלַּע֙ כָּל־ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ שִׁחֵ֖ת מִבְצָרָ֑יו וַיֶּ֙רֶב֙ בְּבַת־ יְהוּדָ֔ה תַּאֲנִיָּ֖ה וַאֲנִיָּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·yāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy kə·’ō·w·yêḇ bil·la‘ yiś·rā·’êl bil·la‘ kāl- ’ar·mə·nō·w·ṯe·hā ši·ḥêṯ miḇ·ṣā·rāw way·ye·reḇ bə·ḇaṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh ta·’ă·nî·yāh wa·’ă·nî·yāh
verses.literal: The Lord is like an enemy He has swallowed up Israel He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for the Daughter of Judah
verses.literalPt: Tornou-se o Senhor como inimigo; devorou a Israel, devorou a todos os seus palácios, destruiu as suas fortalezas; e multiplicou na filha de Judá a lamentação e a tristeza.

verses.original: וַיַּחְמֹ֤ס כַּגַּן֙ שֻׂכּ֔וֹ שִׁחֵ֖ת מוֹעֲד֑וֹ שִׁכַּ֨ח יְהוָ֤ה׀ בְּצִיּוֹן֙ מוֹעֵ֣ד וְשַׁבָּ֔ת וַיִּנְאַ֥ץ בְּזַֽעַם־ אַפּ֖וֹ מֶ֥לֶךְ וְכֹהֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yaḥ·mōs kag·gan śuk·kōw ši·ḥêṯ mō·w·‘ă·ḏōw šik·kaḥ Yah·weh bə·ṣî·yō·wn mō·w·‘êḏ wə·šab·bāṯ way·yin·’aṣ bə·za·‘am- ’ap·pōw me·leḵ wə·ḵō·hên
verses.literal: He has laid waste His tabernacle like a garden booth He has destroyed His place of meeting The LORD has made Zion forget . . . her appointed feasts and Sabbaths In His fierce anger . . . He has despised both king and priest
verses.literalPt: E arrancou o seu tabernáculo com violência, como se fosse a de uma horta; destruiu o lugar da sua congregação; o SENHOR, em Sião, pôs em esquecimento a festa solene e o sábado, e na indignação da sua ira rejeitou com desprezo o rei e o sacerdote.

verses.original: זָנַ֨ח אֲדֹנָ֤י׀ מִזְבְּחוֹ֙ נִאֵ֣ר מִקְדָּשׁ֔וֹ הִסְגִּיר֙ בְּיַד־ אוֹיֵ֔ב חוֹמֹ֖ת אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ ק֛וֹל נָתְנ֥וּ בְּבֵית־ יְהוָ֖ה כְּי֥וֹם מוֹעֵֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: zā·naḥ ’ă·ḏō·nāy miz·bə·ḥōw ni·’êr miq·dā·šōw his·gîr bə·yaḏ- ’ō·w·yêḇ ḥō·w·mōṯ ’ar·mə·nō·w·ṯe·hā qō·wl nā·ṯə·nū bə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh kə·yō·wm mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: The Lord has rejected His altar He has abandoned His sanctuary He has delivered the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy They have raised a shout in the house of the LORD as on the day of an appointed feast
verses.literalPt: Rejeitou o Senhor o seu altar, detestou o seu santuário; entregou na mão do inimigo os muros dos seus palácios; deram gritos na casa do SENHOR, como em dia de festa solene.

verses.original: חָשַׁ֨ב יְהוָ֤ה׀ לְהַשְׁחִית֙ חוֹמַ֣ת בַּת־ צִיּ֔וֹן נָ֣טָה קָ֔ו לֹא־ הֵשִׁ֥יב יָד֖וֹ מִבַּלֵּ֑עַ וַיַּֽאֲבֶל־ חֵ֥ל וְחוֹמָ֖ה יַחְדָּ֥ו אֻמְלָֽלוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥā·šaḇ Yah·weh lə·haš·ḥîṯ ḥō·w·maṯ baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn nā·ṭāh qāw lō- hê·šîḇ yā·ḏōw mib·bal·lê·a‘ way·ya·’ă·ḇel- ḥêl wə·ḥō·w·māh yaḥ·dāw ’um·lā·lū
verses.literal: The LORD determined to destroy the wall of the Daughter of Zion He stretched out a measuring line and did not withdraw His hand from destroying He made the ramparts and walls lament together they waste away
verses.literalPt: Intentou o SENHOR destruir o muro da filha de Sião; estendeu o cordel sobre ele, não retirou a sua mão destruidora; fez gemer o antemuro e o muro; estão eles juntamente enfraquecidos.

verses.original: טָבְע֤וּ בָאָ֙רֶץ֙ שְׁעָרֶ֔יהָ אִבַּ֥ד וְשִׁבַּ֖ר בְּרִיחֶ֑יהָ מַלְכָּ֨הּ וְשָׂרֶ֤יהָ בַגּוֹיִם֙ אֵ֣ין תּוֹרָ֔ה גַּם־ נְבִיאֶ֕יהָ לֹא־ מָצְא֥וּ חָז֖וֹן מֵיְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ṭā·ḇə·‘ū ḇā·’ā·reṣ šə·‘ā·re·hā ’ib·baḏ wə·šib·bar bə·rî·ḥe·hā mal·kāh wə·śā·re·hā ḇag·gō·w·yim ’ên tō·w·rāh gam- nə·ḇî·’e·hā lō- mā·ṣə·’ū ḥā·zō·wn Yah·weh
verses.literal: Her gates have sunk into the ground He has destroyed and shattered their bars Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations the law is no more and even her prophets find no vision from the LORD
verses.literalPt: As suas portas caíram por terra; ele destruiu e quebrou os seus ferrolhos; o seu rei e os seus príncipes estão entre os gentios, onde não há lei, nem os seus profetas acham visão alguma do SENHOR.

verses.original: יֵשְׁב֨וּ לָאָ֤רֶץ יִדְּמוּ֙ זִקְנֵ֣י בַת־ צִיּ֔וֹן הֶֽעֱל֤וּ עָפָר֙ עַל־ רֹאשָׁ֔ם חָגְר֖וּ שַׂקִּ֑ים הוֹרִ֤ידוּ לָאָ֙רֶץ֙ רֹאשָׁ֔ן בְּתוּלֹ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: yê·šə·ḇū lā·’ā·reṣ yid·də·mū ziq·nê ḇaṯ- ṣî·yō·wn he·‘ĕ·lū ‘ā·p̄ār ‘al- rō·šām ḥā·ḡə·rū śaq·qîm hō·w·rî·ḏū lā·’ā·reṣ rō·šān bə·ṯū·lōṯ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: The elders of the Daughter of Zion sit on the ground in silence They have thrown dust on their heads and put on sackcloth The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground
verses.literalPt: Estão sentados na terra, silenciosos, os anciãos da filha de Sião; lançam pó sobre as suas cabeças, cingiram sacos; as virgens de Jerusalém abaixam as suas cabeças até à terra.

verses.original: כָּל֨וּ בַדְּמָע֤וֹת עֵינַי֙ חֳמַרְמְר֣וּ מֵעַ֔י נִשְׁפַּ֤ךְ לָאָ֙רֶץ֙ כְּבֵדִ֔י עַל־ שֶׁ֖בֶר בַּת־ עַמִּ֑י בֵּֽעָטֵ֤ף עוֹלֵל֙ וְיוֹנֵ֔ק בִּרְחֹב֖וֹת קִרְיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kā·lū ḇad·də·mā·‘ō·wṯ ‘ê·nay ḥo·mar·mə·rū mê·‘ay niš·paḵ lā·’ā·reṣ kə·ḇê·ḏî ‘al- še·ḇer baṯ- ‘am·mî bê·‘ā·ṭêp̄ ‘ō·w·lêl wə·yō·w·nêq bir·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ qir·yāh
verses.literal: My eyes fail from weeping I am churning within My heart is poured out in grief over the destruction of the daughter of my people because children and infants faint in the streets of the city
verses.literalPt: Já se consumiram os meus olhos com lágrimas, turbadas estão as minhas entranhas, o meu fígado se derramou pela terra por causa do quebrantamento da filha do meu povo; pois desfalecem o menino e a criança de peito pelas ruas da cidade.

verses.original: לְאִמֹּתָם֙ יֹֽאמְר֔וּ אַיֵּ֖ה דָּגָ֣ן וָיָ֑יִן בְּהִֽתְעַטְּפָ֤ם כֶּֽחָלָל֙ בִּרְחֹב֣וֹת עִ֔יר בְּהִשְׁתַּפֵּ֣ךְ נַפְשָׁ֔ם אֶל־ חֵ֖יק אִמֹּתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·’im·mō·ṯām yō·mə·rū ’ay·yêh dā·ḡān wā·yā·yin bə·hiṯ·‘aṭ·ṭə·p̄ām ke·ḥā·lāl bir·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ ‘îr bə·hiš·tap·pêḵ nap̄·šām ’el- ḥêq ’im·mō·ṯām
verses.literal: They cry out to their mothers Where is the grain and wine as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city as their lives fade away in the arms of their mothers
verses.literalPt: Ao desfalecerem, como feridos, pelas ruas da cidade, ao exalarem as suas almas no regaço de suas mães, perguntam a elas: Onde está o trigo e o vinho?

verses.original: מָֽה־ אֲעִידֵ֞ךְ מָ֣ה אֲדַמֶּה־ לָּ֗ךְ הַבַּת֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם מָ֤ה אַשְׁוֶה־ לָּךְ֙ וַאֲנַֽחֲמֵ֔ךְ בְּתוּלַ֖ת בַּת־ צִיּ֑וֹן כִּֽי־ גָד֥וֹל כַּיָּ֛ם שִׁבְרֵ֖ךְ מִ֥י יִרְפָּא־ לָֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: māh- ’ă·‘î·ḏêḵ māh ’ă·ḏam·meh- lāḵ hab·baṯ yə·rū·šā·lim māh ’aš·weh- lāḵ wa·’ă·na·ḥă·mêḵ bə·ṯū·laṯ baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn kî- ḡā·ḏō·wl kay·yām šiḇ·rêḵ mî yir·pā- lāḵ
verses.literal: What can I say for you To what can I compare you O Daughter of Jerusalem To what can I liken you that I may console you O Virgin Daughter of Zion For your wound is as deep as the sea Who can ever heal you
verses.literalPt: Que testemunho te trarei? A quem te compararei, ó filha de Jerusalém? A quem te assemelharei, para te consolar, ó virgem filha de Sião? Porque grande como o mar é a tua quebradura; quem te sarará?

verses.original: נְבִיאַ֗יִךְ חָ֤זוּ לָךְ֙ שָׁ֣וְא וְתָפֵ֔ל וְלֹֽא־ גִלּ֥וּ עַל־ עֲוֺנֵ֖ךְ לְהָשִׁ֣יב שְׁבִיתֵךְ וַיֶּ֣חֱזוּ לָ֔ךְ מַשְׂא֥וֹת שָׁ֖וְא וּמַדּוּחִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: nə·ḇî·’a·yiḵ ḥā·zū lāḵ šāw wə·ṯā·p̄êl wə·lō- ḡil·lū ‘al- ‘ă·wō·nêḵ lə·hā·šîḇ šə·ḇī·ṯēḵ way·ye·ḥĕ·zū lāḵ maś·’ō·wṯ šāw ū·mad·dū·ḥîm
verses.literal: The visions of your prophets were empty and deceptive they did not expose . . . your guilt to ward off your captivity The burdens they envisioned for you were empty and misleading
verses.literalPt: Os teus profetas viram para ti, vaidade e loucura, e não manifestaram a tua maldade, para impedirem o teu cativeiro; mas viram para ti cargas vãs e motivos de expulsão.

verses.original: סָֽפְק֨וּ עָלַ֤יִךְ כַּפַּ֙יִם֙ כָּל־ עֹ֣בְרֵי דֶ֔רֶךְ שָֽׁרְקוּ֙ וַיָּנִ֣עוּ רֹאשָׁ֔ם עַל־ בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הֲזֹ֣את הָעִ֗יר שֶׁיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ כְּלִ֣ילַת יֹ֔פִי מָשׂ֖וֹשׂ לְכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: sā·p̄ə·qū ‘ā·la·yiḵ kap·pa·yim kāl- ‘ō·ḇə·rê ḏe·reḵ šā·rə·qū way·yā·ni·‘ū rō·šām ‘al- baṯ yə·rū·šā·lim hă·zōṯ hā·‘îr še·yō·mə·rū kə·lî·laṯ yō·p̄î mā·śō·wś lə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: All who pass by . . . clap their hands at you in scorn They hiss and shake their heads at the Daughter of Jerusalem Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty the joy of all the earth
verses.literalPt: Todos os que passam pelo caminho batem palmas, assobiam e meneiam as suas cabeças sobre a filha de Jerusalém, dizendo: É esta a cidade que denominavam: perfeita em formosura, gozo de toda a terra?

verses.original: פָּצ֨וּ עָלַ֤יִךְ פִּיהֶם֙ כָּל־ א֣וֹיְבַ֔יִךְ שָֽׁרְקוּ֙ וַיַּֽחַרְקוּ־ שֵׁ֔ן אָמְר֖וּ בִּלָּ֑עְנוּ אַ֣ךְ זֶ֥ה הַיּ֛וֹם שֶׁקִּוִּינֻ֖הוּ מָצָ֥אנוּ רָאִֽינוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: pā·ṣū ‘ā·la·yiḵ pî·hem kāl- ’ō·wy·ḇa·yiḵ šā·rə·qū way·ya·ḥar·qū- šên ’ā·mə·rū bil·lā·‘ə·nū ’aḵ zeh hay·yō·wm šeq·qiw·wî·nu·hū mā·ṣā·nū rā·’î·nū
verses.literal: All your enemies open their mouths against you They hiss and gnash their teeth saying We have swallowed her up . . . This is the day for which we have waited We have lived to see it
verses.literalPt: Todos os teus inimigos abrem as suas bocas contra ti, assobiam, e rangem os dentes; dizem: Devoramo-la; certamente este é o dia que esperávamos; achamo-lo, vimo-lo.

verses.original: עָשָׂ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר זָמָ֗ם בִּצַּ֤ע אֶמְרָתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה מִֽימֵי־ קֶ֔דֶם הָרַ֖ס וְלֹ֣א חָמָ֑ל וַיְשַׂמַּ֤ח עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ אוֹיֵ֔ב הֵרִ֖ים קֶ֥רֶן צָרָֽיִךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh ’ă·šer zā·mām biṣ·ṣa‘ ’em·rā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh mî·mê- qe·ḏem hā·ras wə·lō ḥā·māl way·śam·maḥ ‘ā·la·yiḵ ’ō·w·yêḇ hê·rîm qe·ren ṣā·rā·yiḵ
verses.literal: The LORD has done what He planned He has accomplished His decree which He ordained in days of old He has overthrown you without pity He has let the enemy gloat over you and exalted the horn of your foes
verses.literalPt: Fez o SENHOR o que intentou; cumpriu a sua palavra, que ordenou desde os dias da antiguidade; derrubou, e não se apiedou; fez que o inimigo se alegrasse por tua causa, exaltou o poder dos teus adversários.

verses.original: צָעַ֥ק לִבָּ֖ם אֶל־ אֲדֹנָ֑י חוֹמַ֣ת בַּת־ צִ֠יּוֹן הוֹרִ֨ידִי כַנַּ֤חַל דִּמְעָה֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה אַֽל־ תִּתְּנִ֤י פוּגַת֙ לָ֔ךְ אַל־ תִּדֹּ֖ם בַּת־ עֵינֵֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ṣā·‘aq lib·bām ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nāy ḥō·w·maṯ baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn hō·w·rî·ḏî ḵan·na·ḥal dim·‘āh yō·w·mām wā·lay·lāh ’al- tit·tə·nî p̄ū·ḡaṯ lāḵ ’al- tid·dōm baṯ- ‘ê·nêḵ
verses.literal: The hearts of the people cry out to the Lord O wall of the Daughter of Zion let your tears run down like a river day and night Give yourself no relief and your eyes . . . no rest
verses.literalPt: O coração deles clamou ao Senhor: Ó muralha da filha de Sião, corram as tuas lágrimas como um ribeiro, de dia e de noite; não te dês descanso, nem parem as meninas de teus olhos.

verses.original: ק֣וּמִי׀ רֹ֣נִּי בַלַּיִל לְרֹאשׁ֙ אַשְׁמֻר֔וֹת שִׁפְכִ֤י כַמַּ֙יִם֙ לִבֵּ֔ךְ נֹ֖כַח פְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנָ֑י שְׂאִ֧י אֵלָ֣יו כַּפַּ֗יִךְ עַל־ נֶ֙פֶשׁ֙ עֽוֹלָלַ֔יִךְ הָעֲטוּפִ֥ים בְּרָעָ֖ב בְּרֹ֥אשׁ כָּל־ חוּצֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: qū·mî rōn·nî ḇal·la·yil lə·rōš ’aš·mu·rō·wṯ šip̄·ḵî ḵam·ma·yim lib·bêḵ nō·ḵaḥ pə·nê ’ă·ḏō·nāy śə·’î ’ê·lāw kap·pa·yiḵ ‘al- ne·p̄eš ‘ō·w·lā·la·yiḵ hā·‘ă·ṭū·p̄îm bə·rā·‘āḇ bə·rōš kāl- ḥū·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: Arise cry out in the night from the first watch of the night Pour out your heart like water in the presence of the Lord Lift up your hands to Him for the lives of your children who are fainting from hunger on the corner of every street
verses.literalPt: Levanta-te, clama de noite no princípio das vigias; derrama o teu coração como águas diante da presença do Senhor; levanta a ele as tuas mãos, pela vida de teus filhinhos, que desfalecem de fome à entrada de todas as ruas.

verses.original: רְאֵ֤ה יְהוָה֙ וְֽהַבִּ֔יטָה לְמִ֖י עוֹלַ֣לְתָּ כֹּ֑ה אִם־ תֹּאכַ֨לְנָה נָשִׁ֤ים פִּרְיָם֙ עֹלֲלֵ֣י טִפֻּחִ֔ים אִם־ יֵהָרֵ֛ג בְּמִקְדַּ֥שׁ אֲדֹנָ֖י כֹּהֵ֥ן וְנָבִֽיא׃ס
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh Yah·weh wə·hab·bî·ṭāh lə·mî ‘ō·w·lal·tā kōh ’im- tō·ḵal·nāh nā·šîm pir·yām ‘ō·lă·lê ṭip·pu·ḥîm ’im- yê·hā·rêḡ bə·miq·daš ’ă·ḏō·nāy kō·hên wə·nā·ḇî
verses.literal: Look O LORD and consider Whom have You ever treated like this Should women eat their offspring the infants they have nurtured Should priests and prophets be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord . . .
verses.literalPt: Vê, ó SENHOR, e considera a quem fizeste assim! Hão de comer as mulheres o fruto de si mesmas, as crianças que trazem nos braços? Ou matar-se-á no santuário do Senhor o sacerdote e o profeta?

verses.original: שָׁכְב֨וּ לָאָ֤רֶץ חוּצוֹת֙ נַ֣עַר וְזָקֵ֔ן בְּתוּלֹתַ֥י וּבַחוּרַ֖י נָפְל֣וּ בֶחָ֑רֶב הָרַ֙גְתָּ֙ בְּי֣וֹם אַפֶּ֔ךָ טָבַ֖חְתָּ לֹ֥א חָמָֽלְתָּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: šā·ḵə·ḇū lā·’ā·reṣ ḥū·ṣō·wṯ na·‘ar wə·zā·qên bə·ṯū·lō·ṯay ū·ḇa·ḥū·ray nā·p̄ə·lū ḇe·ḥā·reḇ hā·raḡ·tā bə·yō·wm ’ap·pe·ḵā ṭā·ḇaḥ·tā lō ḥā·mā·lə·tā
verses.literal: Both young and old lie together in the dust of the streets My young men and maidens have fallen by the sword You have slain them in the day of Your anger You have slaughtered them without compassion
verses.literalPt: Jazem por terra pelas ruas o moço e o velho, as minhas virgens e os meus jovens vieram a cair à espada; tu os mataste no dia da tua ira; mataste e não te apiedaste.

verses.original: תִּקְרָא֩ כְי֨וֹם מוֹעֵ֤ד מְגוּרַי֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב וְלֹ֥א הָיָ֛ה בְּי֥וֹם אַף־ יְהוָ֖ה פָּלִ֣יט וְשָׂרִ֑יד אֲשֶׁר־ טִפַּ֥חְתִּי וְרִבִּ֖יתִי אֹיְבִ֥י כִלָּֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: tiq·rā ḵə·yō·wm mō·w·‘êḏ mə·ḡū·ray mis·sā·ḇîḇ wə·lō hā·yāh bə·yō·wm ’ap̄- Yah·weh pā·lîṭ wə·śā·rîḏ ’ă·šer- ṭip·paḥ·tî wə·rib·bî·ṯî ’ō·yə·ḇî ḵil·lām
verses.literal: You summoned my terrors on every side as for the day of an appointed feast In the day of the LORD’s anger no . . . one escaped or survived my enemy has destroyed those I nurtured and reared
verses.literalPt: Convocaste os meus temores em redor como num dia de solenidade; não houve no dia da ira do SENHOR quem escapasse, ou ficasse; aqueles que eu trouxe nas mãos e sustentei, o meu inimigo os consumiu.
